hero.title: Full-stack Developer, UI/UX Designer & Software Engineer
hero.description: I'm Ahmad Iqbal, a Computer Science student at Universitas Djuanda. I have expertise in Frontend & Backend Development as well as UI/UX Design. I focus on learning the fundamentals of becoming a Software Engineer.

about.text1: I have a been interest in exploring the world of IT, including software engineering, web development, and UI/UX design. I have learned various aspects such as user interface architecture, design systems, analytical systems, and API integration. I have also worked on personal projects and academic assignments, both independently and collaboratively with peers.
about.text2: Most of my projects utilize JavaScript and frameworks such as React, React Native, Node.js, and Flutter for mobile app development. Additionally, I have a solid understanding of backend processes in web and mobile app development, including database design and API development.
about.text3: Currently, I am pursuing a degree in Computer Science at Universitas Djuanda while building my portfolio through various projects and experiences. This preparation has equipped me to embark on a career in the IT industry.
